fusions.name: Twin Flight
fusions.desc: Looses 2 arrows at once, spread wide apart, each dealing 4 damage with a 30% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Prong Head
fusions.desc: Fires a broad-pronged arrow that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it meets and knocks it back 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Shared Sightline
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles deals 15% more damage and has 1 more Power for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Second Branch
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
